name: daily_report__read_guide
description: Read the daily-report writing guide and the directory it lives in. Returns empty: true when nobody has written one yet.

name: daily_report__write_guide
description: Replace the daily-report writing guide with text the user approved; the guide is plain Markdown.

content.description: Full Markdown body to store as the guide.

name: daily_report__today_activity
description: Today's real work across QuickAgent projects: session prompts, changed files and git commits. Facts only; use them to write the report.

date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

name: daily_report__list
description: Project options and the reports already submitted, read from the company daily-report system. Fails with AUTH_EXPIRED when the workbench login expired.

report_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD to list one day.

name: daily_report__prepare_draft
description: Store the structured daily-report draft and open the workbench page so the user can review it before anything is sent.

report_date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD the report is for.

projects.description: One entry per project worked on that day.

work_content.description: What was done, in the guide's format.

problems.description: Problems hit today; empty when there were none.

remark.description: Anything else the report should carry.

action.description: Update when the day already has a report.

report_id.description: Server id of the existing report being updated.

name: daily_report__submit
description: Submit the stored draft to the company daily-report system. Always asks for one-shot human approval.
